points.description: States that a queue is a data structure (or collection) that stores elements in first in, first out (FIFO) order. Equivalent wording, such as 'the first element added is the first one removed', earns the mark.

Names enqueue and dequeue as the main operations of a queue. Equivalent descriptions, such as 'enqueue adds an element to the back' and 'dequeue removes the element from the front', earn the mark. Both operations must be named.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the FIFO data structure idea (3 marks) and both named operations, enqueue and dequeue (2 marks). Naming only one operation earns no marks for P2 and a student who gives FIFO but no operations earns 3/5. Do not require the model answer's exact wording.
